title: 2. Consumo energético
description: Análisis situacional del consumo. El eje temporal es window_start (tiempo de evento). Sigue las métricas habituales de gestión energética de edificios: perfil de carga, demanda pico, consumo base y factor de carga.

list.name: medio
list.label: Tipo de medidor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT meter_type FROM telemetry_metrics ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Demanda pico (kWh)
panels.description: Máximo consumo agregado en una hora. Es la magnitud por la que las eléctricas facturan la potencia contratada a un cliente comercial, no solo por la energía consumida.

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT window_start, sum(sum_reading) AS total
  FROM telemetry_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT max(total) AS "pico" FROM h

panels.title: Consumo base (kWh)
panels.description: El consumo agregado más bajo de todas las horas del periodo seleccionado. Es el diagnóstico de equipos permanentemente encendidos.

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT window_start, sum(sum_reading) AS total
  FROM telemetry_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT min(total) AS "base" FROM h

panels.title: Factor de carga
panels.description: Media dividida entre pico. Mide cómo de bien se aprovecha la potencia contratada: cercano a 1 indica demanda plana, valores bajos indican picos puntuales que encarecen la factura sin aportar consumo.

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT window_start, sum(sum_reading) AS total
  FROM telemetry_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT avg(total) / NULLIF(max(total), 0) AS "factor de carga" FROM h

SELECT max(distinct_buildings) AS "edificios"
FROM (
  SELECT window_start, sum(distinct_buildings) AS distinct_buildings
  FROM telemetry_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
  GROUP BY 1
) q

panels.title: Consumo kWh por Tipo de medidor

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(window_start, $__interval),
  meter_type AS metric,
  sum(sum_reading) AS "consumo"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)
GROUP BY 1, meter_type
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Perfil de carga por hora del día (kWh)
panels.description: Agrupa las lecturas por hora del día (0 a 23) en una sola barra por hora para todas las fechas del análisis. Revela el patrón típico de actividad diaria de los edificios.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(hour FROM window_start)::int AS "hora",
  sum(sum_reading) AS "consumo"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(window_start, $__interval),
  'emplazamiento ' || site_id AS metric,
  sum(sum_reading) AS "consumo"
FROM telemetry_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND meter_type = '$medio'
GROUP BY 1, site_id
ORDER BY 1
